title: CGST Act s. 7 — Scope of supply (Taxable event under GST) (CGST Act s. 7)

content.overview: Supply is the GST taxable event. Section 7 includes supply of goods or services for consideration in the course or furtherance of business, and the scheduled activities treated as supply even without those elements. Activities in Schedule III are neither supply of goods nor supply of services. Section 7 defines what can be taxed. A receipt that is not a supply is not a GST transaction.

enhancement.statutoryFramework: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, section 7.
essentialIngredients: Consideration, unless a schedule deems supply
Course or furtherance of business, unless a schedule applies
enhancement.detailedExplanation: Section 7(1)(a) is the ordinary supply. Import of services for consideration is included whether or not in the course of business. Schedule I deems specified supplies without consideration, including supplies between related persons or distinct persons when made in the course of business. Schedule II classifies specified transactions as goods or services. Schedule III excludes items such as services by an employee to the employer in the course of employment and sale of land, subject to the enacted text.
examples: A shop sells goods for a price.
An employer pays salary for employment.
Schedule III is the exclusion to check.
A free supply between related persons in business is tested under Schedule I, not assumed to be outside GST.
